blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines – Citing parliamentary courtesy, the Senate finance subcommittee on Tuesday swiftly approved on committee level the Office of the Vice President’s (OVP) proposed 2027 budget of P785.2 million. “Of course, we accorded the OVP with parliamentray courtesy. As I’ve said, it was among the very few agencies that reduced its budget for this year,” Sen. JV Ejercito, chair of the finance committee, told reporters after the budget briefing. He noted that many agencies have actually been requesting for additional or bigger budget despite the government’s limited fiscal space. “But the OVP had a budget cut, just like what the Senate […]...
